exposure: Low estimated fetal weight percentile (EFWc) in the third trimester (measured by Hadlock standard)
Low estimated fetal weight percentile (EFWc) in the third trimester (measured by INTERGROWTH-21st standard)
cohort: The study included 690 singleton pregnancies in China that underwent ultrasonography in the third trimester between March 2015 and March 2016.
finding: Low estimated fetal weight percentile (<5th percentile) in the third trimester was associated with an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes, with the Hadlock standard demonstrating superior predictive accuracy compared to the INTERGROWTH-21st standard.
